svg.title: Every rewrite is a generation you pay for first
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Every rewrite is a generation you pay for first” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn whiteboard in which a four-token query enters a red LLM box costing 420 milliseconds and fans out into two rewrites and a HyDE hypothetical answer, each hitting a dense and a BM25 retriever before merging through RRF to a top ten. Below, a scatter plots measured NDCG gain against added p50 latency for six techniques - rewrite at 180 ms for nothing, step-back 390, HyDE 420, multi-query 510, decomposition 780 - against a dashed 200 millisecond TTFT budget, with the router at 90 milliseconds highlighted for buying the same 0.02 gain. A crossed-out panel shows HyDE diluting the identifier query ORA-01555 from 0.93 to 0.66.
